title: Dumbo. The flying baby elephant.
lines: High in the sky storks are flying.
They carry little bundles in a cloth in their beaks.
And in those bundles are babies for the animals.
A baby bear, a baby kangaroo and a baby giraffe.
But one stork was late.
Very late.
He flew and flew with a big, heavy bundle, to the circus.
Mummy elephant lived there, Mrs Jumbo.
She had been waiting so long for her baby.
The circus is a fun place.
There is a big tent with red and white stripes.
There are clowns with red noses.
Honk honk!
There are acrobats who fly through the air.
There are horses that dance, and lions that jump through a hoop.
And there is a circus train that goes from town to town.
Choo-choo, toooot!
Mummy Jumbo opened the bundle.
And inside was a small, cute, grey baby elephant.
He was so sweet, with his little trunk and his big blue eyes.
All the other elephants said: Ooooh, how cute!
But then the baby elephant sneezed.
Atchoo!
And whoosh, out flopped his ears.
And how big those ears were!
Enormous!
As big as two blankets.
They almost dragged on the ground.
The other elephants started to laugh.
Ha ha ha!
Look at those ears!
He's not Jumbo, he's Dumbo!
And that's how the baby elephant got his name: Dumbo.
Mummy Jumbo loved Dumbo very much.
She rocked him with her trunk and washed him in the bath.
Splish splash!
They played peekaboo with his big ears.
But one day some children teased Dumbo and pulled his ears.
Mummy Jumbo got angry and protected him.
Then the circus bosses locked Mummy Jumbo up.
Dumbo was all alone and sad.
Sob.
But then a little friend came along.
A mouse!
His name was Timothy.
Timothy wore a little red jacket and a little hat.
The other elephants were very scared of the mouse.
Eeeek, a mouse!
And they jumped onto a little barrel.
Hee hee hee!
But Timothy was very kind to Dumbo.
Don't cry, Dumbo, he said.
I'm going to help you.
We're going to make you a star!
In the circus Dumbo had to do a trick.
He had to stand on a ball, on top of a whole tower of elephants.
But Dumbo tripped over his big ears.
Plop!
And the whole elephant tower fell over.
Boom, bonk, crack!
Oh dear!
The tent fell down.
Then Dumbo had to be a clown.
He had to jump from a burning little house into a bucket of water.
Splash!
Everyone laughed.
But Dumbo didn't like it.
He was so sad.
Timothy took Dumbo to visit his mummy.
Mummy Jumbo could put her trunk through the bars.
She rocked Dumbo and sang a soft lullaby.
For a moment Dumbo felt warm and safe again.
One morning Dumbo and Timothy woke up.
They weren't in the circus.
They were at the top of a tall tree!
How did they get there?
There were black crows all around them.
Caw, caw!
Hee hee, laughed the crows.
An elephant in a tree!
Timothy thought hard.
And then he understood.
Dumbo, you flew!
With your big ears!
Your ears are really wings!
But Dumbo didn't dare.
He was scared.
Then the crow had an idea.
He gave Timothy a black crow feather.
Timothy gave the feather to Dumbo.
Here, Dumbo, this is a magic feather.
A magic feather!
If you hold it in your trunk, you can fly!
Dumbo took the feather in his trunk.
He walked to the edge of the rock.
He spread his big ears.
Flap, flap, flap!
And up!
He flew!
He really flew, high through the sky!
Wheee!
The crows cheered.
Caw caw, hooray!
That evening there was another show in the circus.
Dumbo stood on top of the burning little house.
He held the magic feather in his trunk.
He jumped.
But oh no!
The feather fell out of his trunk!
Dumbo got a fright.
I can't fly without my feather!
But Timothy shouted: Dumbo!
The feather isn't magic at all!
You can do it yourself!
Your ears are the magic!
And Dumbo spread his ears.
Flap, flap, flap!
And he flew!
Round and round, all through the circus tent!
He sprayed water on the clowns with his trunk.
Pfffft!
Hee hee hee!
Everyone in the circus clapped and clapped.
Dumbo became the biggest star of the circus.
Mummy Jumbo was set free, and she got a special wagon on the circus train.
Dumbo flew happily around the train.
And nobody laughed at his big ears anymore.
Because those big ears were the most wonderful thing about him.
